basic_details.job_title: IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (IIMK) is hiring for one Software Engineer (.NET) post on a two-year contract. The post pays a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs.35,300/-, which includes Rs.300/- towards telephone allowance. Candidates need a B.Tech/BE/MCA/M.Sc/M.Tech/MS in Software Systems with at least 2 years of relevant experience, or a BCA/BSc/three-year Diploma with at least 3 years of relevant experience, and must not be older than 40 years. Applications are made online at iimk.ac.in, and the last date is 15 November 2026 (5:00 pm).

qualification.details: The notification lists the qualification and experience for the Software Engineer (.NET) post as follows: | B.Tech(CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) / BE(CS/CE/IT/ ECE/EE) / MCA / M.Sc / M. Tech (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or MS in Software Systems or equivalent. Minimum 2 years' relevant post qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc. BCA, BSc(CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE)/ Three-year full-time Diploma in (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or equivalent. Minimum 3 years' relevant post-qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc. Experience in complete lifecycle of web application development. Experience as a full stack developer/mobile app developer. | The required experience depends on the qualification: at least 2 years of post-qualification experience with a qualification in the first group, and at least 3 years with a qualification in the second group.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the IIM Kozhikode website, https://iimk.ac.in/.
Upload your photograph, certificates, CV and signature in the format set out on the online portal.
Submit the online application by 5:00 pm on 15 November 2026.
After you apply, check the IIMK website and your email regularly for any change to the interview schedule.
important_instructions: The appointment is purely on a contract basis. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate. IIM Kozhikode HR can be reached on 0495 2809160/ 366, the phone numbers printed on the notification.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET)
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode (भारतीय प्रबंध संस्थान कोषिक्कोड्) is an Indian Institute of Management. Its campus is at IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode 673570, Kerala. The institute's HR Office issued this notification for a contract position of Software Engineer (.NET).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is a maximum of 40 years as on the date of notification. The notification is dated 26 October 2026. The notification lists the qualification and experience for the Software Engineer (.NET) post as follows: B.Tech(CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) / BE(CS/CE/IT/ ECE/EE) / MCA / M.Sc / M. Tech (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or MS in Software Systems or equivalent. Minimum 2 years' relevant post qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc. BCA, BSc(CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE)/ Three-year full-time Diploma in (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or equivalent. Minimum 3 years' relevant post-qualification experience in Software Development OR IT System Projects OR Website Development OR Mobile Application Development etc. Experience in complete lifecycle of web application development. Experience as a full stack developer/mobile app developer. The required experience depends on the qualification: at least 2 years of post-qualification experience with a qualification in the first group, and at least 3 years with a qualification in the second group. Experience in software code development for web or mobile apps Proficient in application stacks like .NET, MS-SQL etc.OR Experience in React Native, Flutter, JavaScript/TypeScript, RESTful APIs, third-party libraries. Knowledge of UI/UX design principles, Git , npm/yarn. Check the official notification for the full discipline-wise eligibility for the post. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET)
content_sections.text: Apply online through the IIM Kozhikode website, https://iimk.ac.in/. Upload your photograph, certificates, CV and signature in the format set out on the online portal. Submit the online application by 5:00 pm on 15 November 2026. After you apply, check the IIMK website and your email regularly for any change to the interview schedule.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Screening: IIMK will screen eligible applications, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for the practical test and interview. Practical test and interview: The date and time of the practical test and interview will be notified later. The test date will be sent to candidates by e-mail. Verification: If you are selected, your engagement depends on the verification of all your certificates and experience at the time of joining. The Director of IIMK makes the final decision on the selection.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a contract basis. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify the candidate. IIM Kozhikode HR can be reached on 0495 2809160/ 366, the phone numbers printed on the notification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026 for Software Engineer (.NET)?
faq.answer: There is 01 (One) vacancy for Software Engineer (.NET) under Notification No. C-82/2026-IIMK.HR.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET) post?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 15 November 2026, until 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET) post?
faq.answer: You need a B.Tech/BE (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE), MCA, M.Sc, M.Tech (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or MS in Software Systems or equivalent with at least 2 years of relevant experience. Alternatively, a BCA, BSc (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or three-year full-time Diploma (CS/CE/IT/ECE/EE) or equivalent with at least 3 years of relevant experience is accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on the date of notification, which is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET)?
faq.answer: The post pays a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs.35,300/-, which includes Rs.300/- towards telephone allowance.

faq.question: Q6. Is the telephone allowance paid on top of the Rs.35,300 pay?
faq.answer: No. The telephone allowance of Rs.300/- is part of the consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs.35,300/-.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIM Kozhikode Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://iimk.ac.in/ and upload your photograph, certificates, CV and signature in the format set out on the portal. The application must be submitted by 5:00 pm on 15 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET) post?
faq.answer: IIMK will screen eligible applications, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a practical test and interview. The test date will be sent by e-mail, and the Director of IIMK makes the final decision on the selection.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIM Kozhikode Software Engineer (.NET) job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on a contract basis for a period of two years.
